responses.rule: finite removal, r = [1 - (1 - s)^b] / s per component (finite_response_2026_09_26)

school.rule: full average cost per pupil (response 1): a school system sized for the group's pupils

economic_affairs_services.rule: finite removal r = [1 - (1 - s)^b] / s on the scaling test's state estimates, capped at 1; administration takes the main case's general-government responses; 0 where spending is not driven by residents; the amount-weighted blend of the line's subfunctions (all share the line's key)
economic_affairs_services.readings: low at the specifications where general government takes its low response (the band's low end), high elsewhere
economic_affairs_services.profiles: long_run_non_school_full and long_run_non_school_fixed; the proportional reference holds the line at 1

air traffic control and screening: fixed at the low end, the nearest measured transport function (highways) at the high end
federal transit and rail administration: fixed at the low end, the highway response at the high end
general government's adopted treatment of federal administration: fixed at the low end, the administration response at the high end
scaling test, nontoll highways: across states at the low end, within states at the high end, finite removal, capped at 1
scaling test, nontoll highways: across states at the low end, within states at the high end, finite removal, capped at 1
general government's adopted response for state-local administration at both ends

recreation_culture.rule: finite removal r = [1 - (1 - s)^b] / s on the scaling test's state estimates, capped at 1; administration takes the main case's general-government responses; 0 where spending is not driven by residents; the amount-weighted blend of the line's subfunctions (all share the line's key)
recreation_culture.readings: low at the specifications where general government takes its low response (the band's low end), high elsewhere
recreation_culture.profiles: long_run_non_school_full and long_run_non_school_fixed; the proportional reference holds the line at 1

subfunctions.basis: national parks and federal cultural institutions: fixed at the low end, the parks response at the high end
scaling test, parks: across states at the low end, within states at the high end, finite removal, capped at 1

housing_subsidies.rule: household rental assistance at response 1, like the account's other capped means-tested transfers, in every profile; NIPA files it as a subsidy (Table 3.13 line 4, federal housing)
housing_subsidies.overlap: no double charge: NIPA's current surplus of government enterprises includes subsidies received from other levels of government (BEA glossary; MP-5), so under option D a federal payment to a public housing authority is charged here at the rental key and credited inside the enterprise_surplus receipt at the population key; the two offset except for the keys, a mismatch in the group's favour of at most $2.5bn if all of line 4 went to enterprises and about $0.2bn for public housing's operating subsidies [INFERENCE]; not netted

enterprise_surplus.rule: enterprise option D (all enterprises respond: every government enterprise's capital at the enterprise-surplus key and response 1, and the enterprise_surplus receipt at response 1): the enterprises' current surplus (NIPA 3.1 line 19, -$47.46bn national, net of depreciation and before interest) at this response in every profile; set as engine.js sets a receipt response, response_override["receipt:enterprise_surplus"]
enterprise_surplus.key: the case's corrected population share (general_public_services' population cell), by the payload's re-key edits

runs.sept23: uncorrected model at 0.59/0.84 and 0.63/0.66 (the September 23 case)
runs.sept27_uncorrected: uncorrected model at the responses in meta.responses, plus the return on public capital keyed on its own evaluation
runs.sept27: main_case_long_run_2026_09_27 corrections at the responses in meta.responses, plus the return on public capital in meta.capital_return (package evaluateFull)
runs.sept27_capital_at_7pct: beside the case, never in its band: the return at the reported 0.07 on every component (package specsFor rates)
runs.sept27_enterprises_out_option_a: beside the case, never in its band: option A, no enterprise capital and the enterprise_surplus receipt at 0 (package specsFor enterprises A)
